text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The Sharp X68000 was a Japanese home computer released in 1987. It was designed with powerful graphics and sound capabilities and became known for high-quality arcade conversions. The system used a Motorola 68000 processor and featured hardware that closely matched arcade machines of the period. Notable games included Castlevania: Chi no Rondo, Street Fighter II, Final Fight, and Gradius II. The X68000 developed a dedicated following due to its technical capabilities and software library.
